programme.title: The Real Jane Austen
programme.desc: Drama-documentary exploring the life of Jane Austen. Location shots of her homes in Steventon and Chawton and extracts from adaptations of her work are also featured.

programme.title: Katharine Schlesinger Remembers... Northanger Abbey
programme.desc: Katharine Schlesinger looks back on the filming of the 1987 adaptation of Northanger Abbey, Jane Austen's ode to the gothic and her love letter to literature. Katharine talks about how this was her first on-screen role and considers the similarities between her personal experience and that of her character Catherine Morland, who is coming out into society for the first time.

programme.title: Northanger Abbey
programme.desc: A young girl, whose head is full of romantic and melodramatic notions, goes to stay with the wealthy Tilney family. Through her adventures, Catherine Morland comes to learn that marriage in the society of her day is determined not by true love but by wealth and social status.

programme.title: Prost
programme.desc: Alain Prost channels his grief into racing amid fierce competition with new teammate, Ayrton Senna, sparking one of the most iconic rivalries in sporting history.

programme.title: Wildlife on One
programme.desc: David Attenborough investigates some real dragons, lizards with characteristics as extraordinary as their mythical ancestors. Drawn to fire and sporting amazing colours, the lizards can even fly.

programme.title: The Day the Dinosaurs Died
programme.desc: Experts suspect that the dinosaurs were wiped out after a city-sized asteroid smashed into the Gulf of Mexico causing a huge crater. But, until now, they haven't had any proof. In a world first, evolutionary biologist Ben Garrod joins a multi-million pound drilling expedition into the exact spot the asteroid hit to get hard evidence of the link. The team overcomes huge obstacles as it attempts to drill 1500 metres beneath sea level to pull up rock from the Chicxulub crater.

programme.title: Amanda Root and Sophie Thompson Remember... Persuasion
programme.desc: Actors Amanda Root and Sophie Thompson look back on their roles in the BBC's 1995 adaptation of Jane Austen's Persuasion, a story of missed opportunities and lost love. The pair discuss how this bold adaptation was filmed in a naturalistic style, with minimal lighting and hardly any make-up, a fitting approach to a novel that was itself ahead of its time.

programme.title: Persuasion
programme.desc: England, 1814. It's several years since Anne Elliot was persuaded by her friend to reject the marriage proposal from Captain Wentworth, a naval rating who is now a prosperous captain. He returns to find Anne's family on the brink of financial ruin. Amid the etiquette of social arrangements, their reunion gradually gives voice to long-buried emotions.

programme.title: Nine to Five
programme.desc: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant.
